name: Tonim
bio: I build Minecraft server systems, developer tools, and local-first interactive apps. My projects connect gameplay, useful automation, and interfaces that make complex systems easier to understand.

projects.title: PlexonPanel
projects.description: A coordinated control plane for Paper servers: pairing, telemetry, host agents, and recovery tooling.

projects.title: Desktop Companion
projects.description: A local-first Windows companion that brings Minecraft skins to life with 3D animation and expressive eyes.

projects.title: Plexon Command Center
projects.description: A responsive operations interface for server pairing, observability, and the PlexonPanel control plane.

projects.title: Neural Core
projects.description: A personal knowledge network for conversation archives, with an interactive 3D graph and browser-local storage.
